title: Remanence: open tape archival infrastructure and the REM-OBJECT format
description: Remanence is open Rust infrastructure for writing archives to LTO tape and reading them back decades later: library control, tape I/O, erasure-coded parity, and a self-describing on-tape object format. The repository implements REM-OBJECT, its REM-ENCRYPT profile, and an experimental generation-2 REM-PARITY layout; the REM-PARITY publication candidate still describes generation 1. Licensing is path-specific: Rust code is Apache-2.0, specification prose is CC-BY-4.0, conformance vectors and fixtures are CC0-1.0, and vendored IETF drafts retain their original terms. See LICENSING.md.
